import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

data = """amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,transfer,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

df['is_fraud_label'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Not Fraud', 1: 'Fraud'})

fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(10, 15))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Characteristics', fontsize=16)

sns.boxplot(x='is_fraud_label', y='amount', data=df, ax=axes[0], palette='viridis')
axes[0].set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status')
axes[0].set_xlabel('')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Amount')

sns.histplot(data=df, x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud_label', multiple='dodge', bins=24,
             ax=axes[1], palette='magma', edgecolor='black', discrete=True)
axes[1].set_title('Transaction Hour of Day Distribution by Fraud Status')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day (0-23)')
axes[1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
axes[1].set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
axes[1].set_xlim(-0.5, 23.5)

sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud_label', data=df, ax=axes[2], palette='cividis')
axes[2].set_title('Transaction Type Counts by Fraud Status')
axes[2].set_xlabel('Transaction Type')
axes[2].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png')
